mapper.select: SELECT acua.ID, acua.LOGIC_DEL, acua.REC_VER, acua.TENANT_ID, acua.COST_ID, acua.USER_ID, acua.AMOUNT, acua.OPERATE_TIME, acua.ALLOC_FLAG, su.USER_NAME, su.NICK_NAME FROM account_cost_user_alloc acua LEFT JOIN sys_user su on acua.USER_ID = SU.ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND acua.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND acua.COST_ID = #{dto.costId} ORDER BY acua.ID

SELECT COLLECTED.ID, COLLECTED.USER_ID, COLLECTED.AMOUNT, U.NICK_NAME, AC.PAYMENT_TIME, AC.COST_DESC, AC.REMARK FROM account_cost_user_alloc COLLECTED LEFT JOIN SYS_USER U ON U.ID = COLLECTED.USER_ID AND COLLECTED.ALLOC_FLAG = 0 LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_COST AC ON AC.ID = COLLECTED.COST_ID where COLLECTED.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND COLLECTED.USER_ID <> #{userId} AND COLLECTED.ALLOC_FLAG = 0

SELECT ALLOCATED.ID, ALLOCATED.USER_ID, ALLOCATED.AMOUNT, AC.PAYMENT_TIME, AC.COST_DESC, AC.REMARK FROM account_cost_user_alloc ALLOCATED LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_COST AC ON AC.ID = ALLOCATED.COST_ID where ALLOCATED.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND ALLOCATED.USER_ID = #{userId} AND ALLOCATED.ALLOC_FLAG = 0 GROUP BY AC.ID
UNION ALL
SELECT ALLOCATED.ID, ALLOCATED.USER_ID, ALLOCATED.AMOUNT, AC.PAYMENT_TIME, AC.COST_DESC, AC.REMARK FROM account_cost_user_alloc ALLOCATED LEFT JOIN ACCOUNT_COST AC ON AC.ID = ALLOCATED.COST_ID WHERE 1 = 1 AND AC.LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND ALLOCATED.ALLOC_FLAG = 0 AND AC.ID IN (SELECT DISTINCT ACUA2.COST_ID FROM account_cost_user_alloc ACUA2 WHERE ACUA2.USER_ID = #{userId}) AND AC.USER_ID <> #{userId} GROUP BY AC.ID
